bounded_test.measurement: Retain actual source/rule hashes, changed controls/setting witnesses, all rejected/ambiguous cases, distinct inputs and four-query lessons, Racket call count, CPU time and reviewer time. Apply ordinary acceptance gates before counting verified contributions; candidate-only evidence is not training admission.
bounded_test.scope: Eight jobs in a supplemental owner-controlled comparison: four existing-priority approved extensions, four current-source unresolved-repair/contract-triage candidates; include eb46daa8881c only if still source-matched. All source edits require their own authorized assignment.
bounded_test.statistical_limit: Small feasibility pilot, not a significance claim or global source ranking.
bounded_test.stop_rule: Stop a candidate at either resource cap or first authority mismatch/unresolved lesson ambiguity unless a correction fits the same cap. Stop the pilot after eight jobs or eight reviewer-hours / 80 CPU-minutes, whichever is first. Do not expand repair allocation unless its verified contributions per reviewer-hour exceed the comparator and CPU minutes per verified contribution do not increase; otherwise retain current allocation and report inconclusive or negative outcome.

cost_quality_comparison.break_even: Let q_r and q_p be verified distinct contributions per reviewer-hour for repair and parameter-extension jobs, and c_r/c_p their measured CPU/Racket costs. Prefer repair allocation only when measured quality per chosen common budget exceeds the comparator; no empirical q_r or q_p is estimated from this sample.
cost_quality_comparison.current_allocation: Current main draw remains 90% normal-priority branch and 10% evaluation-focus branch; all normal-priority sources were approved in the issued manifest. No sampled source is in that main pool.
cost_quality_comparison.deduplication: Before Racket labels in the pilot, count unique input hashes and lesson/demo-query hashes; reuse labels only for identical input plus exact rule hash. Report accepted candidates, attempted draws, duplicates and Racket calls separately. No dedup rate measured here.

estimated_cost_proxy.scope: Proxy only: sum of retained stage times on the prior machine. Reading existing receipts before repeat baselines could avoid redundant known-failing work; this is not a measured speedup, repair-time prediction, or permission to skip required final checks.

cost_quality_comparison.expected_quality_per_cost: Hypothesis: unchanged-source defects with retained witnesses can produce more verified teaching contributions per reviewer-hour than untargeted source expansion, because localization/reproduction is already supplied. Retained 96d2d525a266 repair demonstrates that explicit witness scheduling can improve teaching after an initial 3/12 ambiguity failure. Its incremental expected yield versus parametric extension is unmeasured.
cost_quality_comparison.proposed_alternative: Owner-run supplemental pilot compares four equal time-boxed approved-family extension jobs against four source-bound unresolved-repair/contract-triage jobs. It is outside the live assignment draw; preserve all current probabilities, approvals and dataset filters. Rank repair candidates by current-source reproducible teaching/API defect rather than provenance or raw corpus size.
cost_quality_comparison.quality_unit: One candidate clears unchanged acceptance gates and supplies a distinct four-query episode per demonstrated rule setting, all Racket-labeled, with each query checked against declared rivals from demonstrations alone; report production and rotation evidence separately.
